2609.35302.title: Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture
2609.35302.paper_summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{here}.
2609.35302.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）成為我們獲取和分享資訊的核心，它們在塑造全球知識方面扮演著越來越強大的角色。<lb/>然而，隨著這些模型的演變，它們的輸出風險會趨向於一種\textit{生成單一文化}，其所代表的觀點多樣性隨著時間的推移而縮小。<lb/>模型層級的研究通常無法確定在這個過程中哪些特定的主題或觀點被邊緣化或放大。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了一種方法來衡量不同模型家族之間主題顯著性的變化，追踪在後訓練期間哪些主題獲得或失去突出性。<lb/>將此方法應用於氣候變遷話語的案例研究中，我們展示了同質化如何影響不同模型之間多樣解決方案的表現。<lb/>我們還測試了對抗這一趨勢的干預措施，顯示專門化模型可以幫助保留更廣泛的觀點範圍。<lb/>這強調了監測主題顯著性的重要性，以診斷單一文化的風險並確保AI系統反映多元思想。<lb/>數據和代碼可在\href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{這裡}訪問。
